program_name: NRC Industrial Research Assistance Program Financial Assistance
amount_notes: First-time applicants typically receive $75,000-$200,000. Covers up to 80% of eligible internal salary costs and up to 50% of subcontractor costs. Larger projects up to $10M. $414M annual budget. 3,362 firms funded yearly.
organization_types_eligible: Incorporated for-profit Canadian SME with 500 or fewer full-time equivalent employees
eligibility_criteria: Must be incorporated for-profit Canadian SME with 500 or fewer full-time employees
Must be engaged in development and commercialization of innovative technology-driven products, services or processes
Project must involve technological uncertainty — routine development does not qualify
Must have been in operation minimum 12 months prior to application
Must demonstrate clear path to commercialization with viable business plan
exclusions: CRITICAL: Non-profit organizations not eligible for standard IRAP Financial Assistance
Routine software development without technological uncertainty
Organizations with more than 500 full-time employees
Non-Canadian incorporated companies as primary applicant
notes: RELATIONSHIP-BASED program — approval depends heavily on Industrial Technology Advisor (ITA) relationship, not a scored competition. First step is calling 1-877-994-4727 to be assessed for ITA assignment. Stackable with SR&ED tax credits. NOT applicable to non-profits (Emerge Academy excluded). Highly relevant for Sacral Solutions and any for-profit tech client. AI Assist stream ($100M over 5 years) and DI Assist stream ($244.2M launched January 2026) are active sub-programs for AI and defence/dual-use tech respectively. Program transitioning to Canada Innovation Corporation by 2026-27 — monitor for structural changes.
